title: Episode 80 — Kharak Singh Misleads the Sikhs

blocks.text: This page introduces Kharak Singh as a pretender who filled a vacuum after older leadership lines weakened, using lineage claims and public performance to draw uncertain Sikhs toward himself.

He is described as a man from the Bassi subcaste who won attention by displaying miracles in congregation and by claiming that when all the Sodhis perished, the Panth had been left without a religious head.
The narrative condemns that appeal as a strategy to wean away the Sikhs from Khalsa Panth, replacing discipline with spectacle and dependence on a new claimant.
